movies.title: Amélie
movies.hook: A Montmartre waitress with a secret life of tiny kindnesses — Paris as a jewel box, and the best reason to believe in coincidences.

movies.title: Paddington 2
movies.hook: A bear in a duffle coat, a pop-up book, and Hugh Grant having the time of his life. Genuinely one of the kindest films of the century.

movies.title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
movies.hook: Wes Anderson at full confection: a concierge, a stolen painting, and a pastry box of a vanished Europe. Every frame is a dollhouse with a punchline.

movies.title: Little Miss Sunshine
movies.hook: A broken VW bus, a Nietzsche-reading teen, and a child beauty pageant nobody asked for. Failure has never looked this much like love.

movies.title: Singin' in the Rain
movies.hook: Hollywood panics its way into talkies, and Gene Kelly turns a downpour into the most famous dance in movies. Pure, dripping joy.

movies.title: The Intouchables
movies.hook: A paralyzed aristocrat hires the last man anyone would pick as a carer. The friendship that follows is rude, musical, and unexpectedly light.

movies.title: Coco
movies.hook: A boy chases a family secret into the Land of the Dead and comes back with a song. Pixar’s most colorful argument for remembering people.

movies.title: School of Rock
movies.hook: Jack Black weaponizes a substitute-teacher gig into a fourth-grade rock band. The riffs are loud; the heart is louder.

movies.title: Cinema Paradiso
movies.hook: A projectionist, a small Sicilian screen, and a reel of kisses the priest made them cut. Nostalgia that actually earns the lump in your throat.

movies.title: Lady Bird
movies.hook: Sacramento, a thrift-store name, and a mother-daughter war conducted in love. Greta Gerwig’s debut feels like the last year of high school, distilled.

movies.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
movies.hook: One skipped school day, a borrowed Ferrari, and a parade in downtown Chicago. The definitive permission slip to play hooky.

movies.title: Chef
movies.hook: A burnt-out chef hits the road in a Cuban sandwich truck with his son. You will want grilled cheese, Cubanos, and a second chance.

movies.title: Spirited Away
movies.hook: A sullen girl takes a job in a spirit bathhouse to save her parents from a piggish curse. Miyazaki’s masterpiece is strange, generous, and bottomless.

movies.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
movies.hook: A laundromat, a googly-eyed rock, and the multiverse as family therapy. Chaos cinema that somehow lands on kindness.

movies.title: Superbad
movies.hook: Two best friends, one fake ID, and a night that keeps getting worse in the funniest possible way. High-school goodbye energy, bottled.

movies.title: Shaun of the Dead
movies.hook: The zombie apocalypse starts on a Sunday and Shaun barely notices. Cornettos, cricket bats, and the best hangover movie ever made.

movies.title: What We Do in the Shadows
movies.hook: Flatmates who happen to be centuries-old vampires, filmed like a dorky documentary. The running gag about not being invited in never gets old.
movies.wikipedia: What We Do in the Shadows (film)

movies.title: Hot Fuzz
movies.hook: A super-cop is dumped in a too-perfect village. Then the garden centre gets involved. Edgar Wright turns a cozy mystery into a Michael Bay parody.

movies.title: The Big Lebowski
movies.hook: The Dude abides, a rug is peed on, and a kidnapping plot nobody understands unspools in bowling shoes. Peak slacker-noir.

movies.title: Groundhog Day
movies.hook: A weatherman is sentenced to February 2 until he becomes a decent human. The rare comedy that doubles as a philosophy seminar.

movies.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
movies.hook: A foster kid and a grumpy bushman go on the run in the New Zealand wild. Taika Waititi’s warmest, funniest hike.

movies.title: Some Like It Hot
movies.hook: Two musicians join an all-girl band to hide from the mob. Marilyn Monroe, a yacht, and the greatest last line in comedy.

movies.title: Booksmart
movies.hook: Two overachievers try to cram four years of partying into one night. Olivia Wilde’s debut is filthy, tender, and surgically well-timed.

movies.title: In Bruges
movies.hook: Hitmen on timeout in the prettiest city in Belgium. Martin McDonagh’s first film is blasphemous, melancholy, and very, very funny.

movies.title: The Death of Stalin
movies.hook: The Soviet inner circle scrambles for power over a corpse. Armando Iannucci turns a historical nightmare into a vicious farce.

movies.title: Knives Out
movies.hook: A detective in a cream knit, a family of vultures, and a country house full of knives. Rian Johnson makes the whodunnit fizzy again.

movies.title: Airplane!
movies.hook: A disaster movie with the jokes left in — every single one. “Don’t call me Shirley” energy from first frame to last.

movies.title: Die Hard
movies.hook: A New York cop, barefoot, in an L.A. skyscraper on Christmas Eve. Still the template for “one man, one building, bad odds.”

movies.title: No Country for Old Men
movies.hook: A satchel of drug money, a bolt-gun assassin, and the Coens at their most merciless. Chance has never sounded so much like a coin toss.

movies.title: The Silence of the Lambs
movies.hook: Clarice Starling needs a monster to catch a monster. Two conversations through glass will stay in your head longer than the scares.

movies.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
movies.hook: A two-hour chase across the desert, mostly in-camera, mostly insane. George Miller reinvented the action movie and barely needed Max.

movies.title: North by Northwest
movies.hook: Cary Grant is the wrong man, a crop duster is the wrong plane, and Mount Rushmore is the wrong place for a fight. Hitchcock in tuxedo mode.

movies.title: The Bourne Ultimatum
movies.hook: Paul Greengrass’s handheld manhunt: Waterloo Station, Tangier rooftops, a man who remembers just enough to be dangerous.

movies.title: Sicario
movies.hook: A convoy into Juárez scored like a horror film. Villeneuve and Deakins make the war on drugs feel like walking into a minefield at dusk.

movies.title: Prisoners
movies.hook: Two girls vanish after Thanksgiving. Hugh Jackman unravels; Jake Gyllenhaal’s detective does not blink. A vice that only tightens.

movies.title: The Dark Knight
movies.hook: A crime epic in a cape. Heath Ledger’s Joker turns a superhero movie into a civic nightmare you cannot look away from.

movies.title: Children of Men
movies.hook: The last pregnancy on Earth, smuggled through a collapsing Britain. Those long takes aren’t a stunt — they’re how panic actually feels.

movies.title: Zodiac
movies.hook: A cipher, a basement, decades of almost. Fincher’s true-crime film is about the itch of not knowing, and it never lets you scratch it.

movies.title: Jaws
movies.hook: A beach town, a mechanical shark that barely worked, and John Williams’s two notes. Spielberg invented the summer movie by ruining swimming.

movies.title: Rear Window
movies.hook: A broken-legged photographer spies on his courtyard and thinks he sees a murder. Hitchcock turns looking itself into a thriller.

movies.title: Inception
movies.hook: Dreams inside dreams, a spinning top, and a heist crew that breaks into the mind. Nolan’s puzzle box still argues with itself after the credits.

movies.title: Mulholland Drive
movies.hook: A blonde, a brunette, a blue box, and Hollywood as a fever. Lynch’s night drive is the one you rewatch to argue about, not to solve.

movies.title: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
movies.hook: A couple erases each other and the memories fight back. Kaufman and Gondry make heartbreak look like a collapsing beach house.
movies.wikipedia: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind

movies.title: Arrival
movies.hook: A linguist learns an alien language that rearranges time. Villeneuve’s first contact story is quiet, devastating, and shaped like a circle.

movies.title: Primer
movies.hook: Two engineers build a time machine in a garage and immediately make everything worse. The diagrams are the point; so is the dread.

movies.title: The Prestige
movies.hook: Rival magicians in Victorian London, each willing to ruin a life for a better trick. Are you watching closely? You still might miss it.

movies.title: Being John Malkovich
movies.hook: A portal on the 7½th floor dumps you into John Malkovich for fifteen minutes. Spike Jonze’s first feature is as weird as that sentence.

movies.title: Donnie Darko
movies.hook: A jet engine, a rabbit, and a suburban teen who might be saving the world. Midnight-movie mythology that still feels like a private discovery.

movies.title: The Matrix
movies.hook: Take the red pill. Bullet time, leather, and a simulation so persuasive it rewired the decade. Still the coolest philosophy lecture ever shot.

movies.title: Annihilation
movies.hook: A shimmer on the coast rewrites DNA like a bad remix. Natalie Portman walks into a prism and the soundtrack does the rest.

movies.title: Ex Machina
movies.hook: A coder, a reclusive genius, and an android in a glass house. The Turing test as a chamber piece — intimate, cold, and perfectly sprung.

movies.title: Interstellar
movies.hook: Dust-bowl Earth, a wormhole, and love as a dimension you can navigate. Nolan goes maximal; the docked-ship docking still knocks the air out.

movies.title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
movies.hook: A bone, a waltz, a red eye named HAL. Kubrick’s silent-ish epic is still the most confident “what are we?” movie ever made.

movies.title: Parasite
movies.hook: A poor family infiltrates a rich one, and the house has a basement. Bong Joon-ho’s genre grenade is funny until it isn’t.

movies.title: My Neighbor Totoro
movies.hook: Two sisters, a camphor tree, and a cat-bus. Miyazaki’s gentlest film is basically a nap in the countryside — in the best way.

movies.title: Kiki's Delivery Service
movies.hook: A young witch, a seaside town, and the creative slump nobody warns you about. Comfort viewing with a quietly grown-up heartbeat.

movies.title: Little Women
movies.hook: Gerwig braids the March sisters across time so the attic feels like now. Saoirse Ronan and Florence Pugh make ambition look like love.

movies.title: Before Sunrise
movies.hook: Two strangers get off a train in Vienna and walk until morning. All talk, no plot — and somehow the most convincing crush on film.

movies.title: About Time
movies.hook: A man inherits the ability to time-travel, then learns the trick is not to. Richard Curtis, unexpectedly, makes a film about ordinary days.

movies.title: The Princess Bride
movies.hook: True love, a six-fingered man, and “as you wish.” A fairy tale that winks without ever breaking the spell.

movies.title: Fantastic Mr. Fox
movies.hook: Stop-motion animals in corduroy, stealing cider and staging a heist. Wes Anderson’s warmest movie is also his most tactile.

movies.title: Paterson
movies.hook: A bus driver named Paterson writes poems in Paterson, New Jersey. Jarmusch turns a week of small repetitions into something like grace.

movies.title: Moonrise Kingdom
movies.hook: Two kids elope on a New England island with a record player and a cat. Precocious, pastel, and sneakily moving.

movies.title: You've Got Mail
movies.hook: AOL chat, a children’s bookshop, and enemies who are already in love. Peak ’90s comfort, with Tom Hanks and Meg Ryan in their final form.

movies.title: The Holiday
movies.hook: A house swap between L.A. and a Surrey cottage, plus Kate Winslet, Cameron Diaz, and a golden-age screenwriter. Fireplace cinema.

movies.title: Frances Ha
movies.hook: Black-and-white New York, a dancer without a plan, and Greta Gerwig running through the street to Bowie. Failure never looked this alive.

movies.title: Marcel the Shell with Shoes On
movies.hook: A one-inch shell with shoes gives a documentary tour of his house. Tiny, sincere, and somehow more moving than most live-action dramas.
movies.wikipedia: Marcel the Shell with Shoes On (2021 film)

movies.title: The Station Agent
movies.hook: A man who wants to be left alone inherits a train depot in New Jersey. Friendship arrives anyway, with coffee and a hot-dog cart.

movies.title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
movies.hook: A painter is hired to secretly portrait a woman who refuses to be looked at. Céline Sciamma turns a glance into an event.
movies.wikipedia: Portrait of a Lady on Fire

movies.title: In the Mood for Love
movies.hook: Two neighbors in 1960s Hong Kong whose spouses are having an affair. Wong Kar-wai makes withheld desire look like the most elegant thing on Earth.

movies.title: When Harry Met Sally...
movies.hook: Can men and women be friends? Rob Reiner and Nora Ephron spend a decade answering, with a Katz’s Deli scene you already know by heart.

movies.title: Call Me by Your Name
movies.hook: A summer in Lombardy, a peach, a bicycle, and a piano that will wreck you in the last five minutes. Desire as weather.

movies.title: La La Land
movies.hook: A jazz pianist and an actress dance on a hill as L.A. traffic waits. Chazelle’s musical is fizzy until it chooses honesty over the encore.

movies.title: Casablanca
movies.hook: Rick’s Café, a stolen letter of transit, and “here’s looking at you, kid.” The studio system’s perfect accident still works like a charm.

movies.title: The Apartment
movies.hook: A clerk lends out his flat to executives and falls for the woman they send there. Wilder finds the ache inside the office Christmas party.

movies.title: Moonlight
movies.hook: Three acts, one life, Miami moonlight. Barry Jenkins’s film is about a look across a diner counter that takes decades to arrive.

movies.title: Past Lives
movies.hook: Childhood sweethearts, twenty years, and a night in New York that might be a closing door. Celine Song makes inaction feel seismic.

movies.title: Pride & Prejudice
movies.hook: Keira Knightley in a misty English field, a hand flex that launched a thousand gifs, and Joe Wright’s most swooning period piece.

movies.title: Her
movies.hook: A lonely man falls in love with his operating system. Spike Jonze’s pastel future is funny until it becomes a breakup you recognize.

movies.title: Carol
movies.hook: A department-store glance in 1950s New York, shot like a stolen photograph. Cate Blanchett and Rooney Mara make restraint feel volcanic.

movies.title: The Shining
movies.hook: The Overlook Hotel, a typewriter, and a hedge maze. Kubrick turns cabin fever into geometry — and “Here’s Johnny!” into folklore.

movies.title: Get Out
movies.hook: A weekend with the girlfriend’s parents goes from awkward to surgical. Jordan Peele’s debut is a sundown scare with a brain.

movies.title: Hereditary
movies.hook: A miniature artist, a family curse, and one of the nastiest mid-film turns in modern horror. Ari Aster does not flinch. You might.

movies.title: Alien
movies.hook: A truckers-in-space crew answers a distress call. Ridley Scott and H. R. Giger build a haunted house in orbit, and Ripley walks out of it.

movies.title: The Babadook
movies.hook: A pop-up book that will not stay in the trash. Jennifer Kent’s grief-horror is a monster in a top hat — and a mother at the end of her rope.

movies.title: A Quiet Place
movies.hook: Make a sound and you die. Krasinski’s creature feature is a family drama conducted in breath, sign language, and bare feet.

movies.title: The Witch
movies.hook: A Puritan family, a New England wood, and a goat named Black Philip. Eggers’s debut is folk horror whispered in period English.

movies.title: Pan's Labyrinth
movies.hook: A girl in Franco’s Spain is offered a fairy-tale that might be real. Del Toro’s pale man is unforgettable; so is the ending you choose to believe.

movies.title: Let the Right One In
movies.hook: A bullied boy in a Swedish snowscape befriends the child next door, who happens to be a vampire. Tender, bloody, and very cold.

movies.title: The Thing
movies.hook: Antarctica, a husky, and a blood test you do not want to fail. Carpenter’s paranoia machine still has the best practical-effects nightmares.

movies.title: Psycho
movies.hook: A stolen wad of cash, a motel off the highway, and a shower that changed censorship forever. Hitchcock’s cheap little black-and-white gamble.

movies.title: Midsommar
movies.hook: A breakup trip to a Swedish midsummer festival where the sun never sets. Ari Aster’s daylight folk horror is smiling the whole time.

movies.title: Rosemary's Baby
movies.hook: A sunny Dakota apartment, overly helpful neighbors, and a pregnancy that does not feel like yours. Polanski’s slow invasion of the body.

movies.title: It Follows
movies.hook: A curse that walks toward you at pedestrian speed, forever. Suburban wide shots and a synth score turn any stranger on the sidewalk into a threat.

movies.title: The Exorcist
movies.hook: Georgetown, a priest in a crisis of faith, and a child’s bedroom that becomes a battleground. Still the one that makes people leave the theater.

movies.title: Whiplash
movies.hook: A jazz drummer and a teacher who thinks abuse is a teaching method. Damien Chazelle cuts the final solo like a fight scene.

movies.title: There Will Be Blood
movies.hook: Daniel Day-Lewis drinks your milkshake. Paul Thomas Anderson’s oil-and-religion epic is a monument to American appetite.

movies.title: Uncut Gems
movies.hook: Adam Sandler as a jeweler who cannot stop betting. The Safdies score anxiety like a club track and never give you a breath.

movies.title: Requiem for a Dream
movies.hook: Four New Yorkers chase a high until the montage turns into a trap. Aronofsky’s most relentless film — not a casual Tuesday watch.

movies.title: City of God
movies.hook: A kid with a camera grows up in a Rio favela as a drug war swallows his friends. Kinetic, brutal, and told with astonishing verve.

movies.title: Oldboy
movies.hook: Fifteen years in a room, then a hammer in a corridor. Park Chan-wook’s revenge tragedy is famous for one shot and unforgettable for the rest.

movies.title: Nightcrawler
movies.hook: Jake Gyllenhaal’s wide-eyed stringer hunts L.A. accidents for TV. A night drive through American hustle, shot like a predator documentary.

movies.title: Come and See
movies.hook: A Belarusian boy joins the partisans and walks into the end of childhood. Elem Klimov’s war film is not “about” war so much as inside it.

movies.title: The Pianist
movies.hook: Adrien Brody as Władysław Szpilman, surviving the Warsaw ghetto with a piano in his head. Polanski’s most personal film, and his quietest.

movies.title: The Social Network
movies.hook: Harvard, depositions, and a friendship wrecked at the speed of code. Fincher and Sorkin make a founding myth that feels like a knife fight.

movies.title: Dunkirk
movies.hook: Land, sea, and air braided into one evacuation. Nolan’s war film is almost dialogue-free — just engines, clocks, and the Channel.

movies.title: Heat
movies.hook: Pacino vs. De Niro in a downtown L.A. shootout that still sounds like the real city. Mann’s cops-and-robbers opus is a cathedral of professionalism.

movies.title: Goodfellas
movies.hook: Henry Hill’s life in the mob, from Copacabana tracking shot to the day the music stops. Scorsese at full throttle, funny until the coke runs out.

movies.title: Gladiator
movies.hook: A general becomes a slave becomes a name the Colosseum cannot stop chanting. Ridley Scott’s sword-and-sandal epic still has that Hans Zimmer swell.

movies.title: Drive
movies.hook: A Hollywood stunt driver moonlights as a getaway man. Refn’s neon fairy tale is mostly silence, a scorpion jacket, and sudden, shocking violence.

movies.title: Memories of Murder
movies.hook: Rural detectives chase South Korea’s first serial killer and keep getting it wrong. Bong Joon-ho’s police procedural is funny, then hollowed-out.

movies.title: Seven Samurai
movies.hook: Villagers hire seven warriors to survive a bandit harvest. Kurosawa invents the modern action ensemble — and makes 3.5 hours feel like a siege you joined.

movies.title: Hard Boiled
movies.hook: Chow Yun-fat in a hospital shootout that rewired action cinema. John Woo’s heroic bloodshed is doves, dual pistols, and absolutely no chill.

movies.title: The Killer
movies.hook: A hitman who wants out, a singer who cannot see, and a cathedral finale. Woo’s ballet of bullets still looks like it was shot yesterday.

movies.title: Police Story
movies.hook: Jackie Chan wrecks a shopping mall and a bus with his own body. Stunt work so feral the closing blooper reel is part of the thesis.

movies.title: The Raid: Redemption
movies.hook: A SWAT team enters a Jakarta tower and the elevator is a trap. Gareth Evans turns corridors into a martial-arts meat grinder.

movies.title: Kill Bill: Volume 1
movies.hook: Uma Thurman in a yellow tracksuit walking into the House of Blue Leaves. Tarantino’s revenge opera is silhouettes, gore, and a rusty blade of a score.

movies.title: Casino Royale
movies.hook: Bond gets the parkour, the poker, and the Vesper. Craig’s first 007 is a bruiser in a dinner jacket — the reboot that actually stuck.

movies.title: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
movies.hook: Gary Oldman as Smiley, hunting a mole through cigarette smoke and badly lit offices. The anti-Bourne spy film: whispers, glances, a teapot of dread.

movies.title: Mission: Impossible – Fallout
movies.hook: Tom Cruise actually HALOs, actually helicopters, actually breaks an ankle and keeps shooting. The gold standard of “we did this for real.”

movies.title: Black Panther
movies.hook: Wakanda unhidden, a Killmonger who might be right, and a world that suddenly wanted every superhero movie to look this considered.

movies.title: Logan
movies.hook: A rusted Wolverine, a dying Xavier, a road movie that bleeds. The rare superhero film that feels like a Western at last call.

movies.title: Saving Private Ryan
movies.hook: Omaha Beach, twenty minutes that rewrote the war movie. Spielberg’s rescue mission is about the bill that never stops coming due.

movies.title: Apocalypse Now
movies.hook: A boat upriver toward a bald colonel who knows the horror. Coppola’s Vietnam fever dream is napalm, Wagner, and a mission that eats its orders.
Two corporals, one message, a trench system shot like a single held breath. Mendes makes the Great War feel like a video-game you cannot pause.

movies.title: Full Metal Jacket
movies.hook: Parris Island first, Hue second. Kubrick splits the war movie in half and both halves sting — especially the one with a rifle named Charlene.

movies.title: Twister
movies.hook: Dorothy the sensor pack, a flying cow, and Helen Hunt driving into the funnel. Peak ’90s disaster: science, divorce, and an F5.

movies.title: The Poseidon Adventure
movies.hook: New Year’s Eve, a rogue wave, and a Christmas tree used as a ladder. The template for “up is down” disaster cinema, in wet formalwear.

movies.title: Titanic
movies.hook: The ship sinks; the drawing doesn’t. Cameron’s blockbuster is a disaster movie that accidentally became the romance of a generation.

movies.title: The Towering Inferno
movies.hook: A glass tower, a skipped-inspection wiring job, and Steve McQueen versus Paul Newman versus fire. The disaster-movie all-star game.

movies.title: Don't Look Up
movies.hook: A comet is coming and the morning shows want a segment. McKay’s satire of the end of the world is louder than it is subtle — on purpose.

movies.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon
movies.hook: A stolen sword, a desert interlude, and two warriors who never quite touch. Ang Lee makes wuxia float — bamboo, rooftops, withheld confession.

movies.title: Enter the Dragon
movies.hook: Bruce Lee walks onto an island tournament and the ’70s action movie never recovers. The nunchaku, the hall of mirrors, the why-of-it.

movies.title: Ip Man
movies.hook: Donnie Yen as the Wing Chun master in occupied Foshan, fighting for a city that is running out of rice. Biopic as one long, precise duel.

movies.title: Kung Fu Hustle
movies.hook: A wannabe gangster in Pig Sty Alley picks the wrong slum. Stephen Chow detonates martial-arts cinema into Looney Tunes with bruises.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse
movies.hook: Miles Morales, a thousand animation styles, and a leap of faith. The superhero movie that looked like a comic book and felt like a pop song.

movies.title: The Incredibles
movies.hook: A suburban super-family in hiding, a cape that is a workplace hazard, and Brad Bird’s argument for excellence. Still Pixar’s coolest.

movies.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
movies.hook: A whip, a boulder, and a man who hates snakes more than Nazis. Spielberg and Lucas invent the modern adventure film in a fedora.

movies.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade
movies.hook: Sean Connery as Dad, a tank, a leap of faith that is also a dad joke. The rare sequel that adds heart without sanding off the pulp.
movies.wikipedia: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade

movies.title: Rush Hour
movies.hook: Jackie Chan and Chris Tucker, a kidnap plot, and “do you understand the words that are coming out of my mouth?” Buddy-cop as culture clash.

movies.title: Thunderbolts*
movies.hook: Marvel’s reject drawer forms a team and Florence Pugh does the emotional heavy lifting. A superhero movie that is, unexpectedly, about depression.

movies.title: Superman
movies.hook: James Gunn’s cape-and-dog reboot: kindness as a superpower, and a world that has forgotten what that looks like. The suit still works.

movies.title: Mission: Impossible – The Final Reckoning
movies.hook: Cruise versus the Entity, versus a submarine, versus physics. The franchise’s last (?) flex is still just a man hanging off something enormous.

movies.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl
movies.hook: Johnny Depp walks off a sinking boat like he meant to. A theme-park ride that accidentally became a swashbuckler with real weather and better jokes.
movies.wikipedia: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl

movies.title: Captain Blood
movies.hook: Errol Flynn becomes a star by becoming a pirate. Warner Bros. salt, swordplay, and the template every later corsair is still quoting.

movies.title: The Sea Hawk
movies.hook: Flynn again, this time as an Elizabethan privateer with Korngold pouring gold into the speakers. Court intrigue, then cannons.

movies.title: The Mask of Zorro
movies.hook: Anthony Hopkins teaches Antonio Banderas how to be a legend; Catherine Zeta-Jones steals a scene with a sword. Black-mask popcorn at its most generous.

movies.title: Yojimbo
movies.hook: A nameless ronin plays two crime bosses against each other and scratches his beard. Kurosawa invents the spaghetti Western before Italy does.

movies.title: 13 Assassins
movies.hook: A suicide mission against a sadistic lord, ending in a village turned into a kill-box. Miike’s samurai film is patience, then carnage.

movies.title: Sanjuro
movies.hook: The Yojimbo ronin babysits a pack of naive young samurai. Kurosawa’s sequel is drier, funnier, and ends on a geyser of a duel.

movies.title: Harakiri
movies.hook: A ragged ronin requests seppuku at a clan house and unravels their honor like a bandage. Kobayashi’s masterpiece is a blade aimed at the system.

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
movies.hook: Nine walkers, one Ring, a New Zealand that became Middle-earth. Jackson’s opening chapter still has the freshest air of the three.
movies.wikipedia: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
movies.hook: Helm’s Deep, Gollum as a tragedy, and a talking tree army. The middle film that refuses to be a placeholder.
movies.wikipedia: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
movies.hook: The Pelennor, the lava, the endings upon endings. Jackson cashes every check the first two films wrote — and then some.
movies.wikipedia: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King

movies.title: Lawrence of Arabia
movies.hook: Lean paints the desert as a state of mind and Peter O’Toole as its mirage. Epic cinema, and a biopic that keeps refusing to explain him.

movies.title: The Revenant
movies.hook: A bear, a betrayal, and Leonardo DiCaprio breathing in frozen daylight. Iñárritu’s survival Western is almost all weather and will.

movies.title: Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World
movies.hook: Russell Crowe’s Surprise hunts and is hunted around Cape Horn. The rare naval film that cares about the surgeon as much as the cannon.
movies.wikipedia: Master and Commander: The Far Side of the World

movies.title: How to Train Your Dragon
movies.hook: A Viking kid sketches a Night Fury instead of killing it. DreamWorks finds a flight sequence that still makes grown-ups quiet.
movies.wikipedia: How to Train Your Dragon (2010 film)

movies.title: Moana
movies.hook: A wayfinder, a demigod with a self-esteem problem, and the ocean as a character. Disney’s most salt-spray musical.

movies.title: Up
movies.hook: A house lifted by balloons, a four-minute marriage, a bird named Kevin. Pixar’s most efficient heartbreak, then a jungle caper.

movies.title: The Last of the Mohicans
movies.hook: Daniel Day-Lewis running through a burning forest to a synthesizer that should not work and does. Frontier romance at a dead sprint.
movies.wikipedia: The Last of the Mohicans (1992 film)

movies.title: The Wizard of Oz
movies.hook: Over the rainbow, then a road of brick, then a curtain. Still the American fairy tale: Kansas grey, Oz too much, home the point.

movies.title: Toy Story
movies.hook: A cowboy, a space ranger, and the first time CGI made you care about plastic. Pixar’s original sin: making toys feel mortal.

movies.title: WALL-E
movies.hook: A lonely trash-compactor, a sleek probe, almost no dialogue. Pixar’s silent movie is a love story and a warning in the same rusted chassis.

movies.title: The Lion King
movies.hook: A murder, a savannah, a warthog named Pumbaa. Disney’s Hamlet with better songs — and a stampede you still feel in your ribs.

movies.title: Princess Mononoke
movies.hook: A cursed prince, a wolf-girl, a forest that fights back. Miyazaki’s most political film is still, somehow, about whether people can share a world.

movies.title: Akira
movies.hook: Neo-Tokyo, a motorcycle, a power that will not stay in a child’s body. The film that dragged Western eyes into anime at full volume.

movies.title: Persepolis
movies.hook: Marjane Satrapi’s childhood in black-and-white panels that move. A revolution, a punk adolescence, a country you leave without leaving it.

movies.title: Coraline
movies.hook: A button-eyed Other Mother and a house that is almost better. Selick’s stop-motion is a children’s film that does not lie about wanting to leave.

movies.title: Isle of Dogs
movies.hook: Exiled pups on a trash island, a boy who jumps after them. Anderson’s Japan is stop-motion tactility and a political fable in fur.

movies.title: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit
movies.hook: A giant rabbit, a vegetable contest, Gromit doing all the thinking. Aardman’s clay still has the best eyebrows in comedy.
movies.wikipedia: Wallace & Gromit: The Curse of the Were-Rabbit

movies.title: The Nightmare Before Christmas
movies.hook: Jack Skellington tries to kidnap Christmas and learns a boundary. Selick and Elfman make Halloween feel like a music box you sleep next to.

movies.title: Kubo and the Two Strings
movies.hook: A boy with a shamisen, a monkey, a beetle, origami that fights. Laika’s most beautiful film is a folktale about the stories we keep.

movies.title: Who Framed Roger Rabbit
movies.hook: Toons and gumshoes share 1947 Los Angeles, and the handshake still looks impossible. Zemeckis’s hybrid is a love letter to chaos.

movies.title: Mary Poppins
movies.hook: A nanny arrives on the east wind and takes the Banks children into a sidewalk chalk drawing. Disney’s live-action/cartoon blend, practically perfect.

movies.title: Space Jam
movies.hook: Jordan in Looney Tunes land, because the ’90s said so. A commercial that became a bedtime movie — and Bill Murray wandering through it.

movies.title: The Adventures of Tintin
movies.hook: Spielberg goes motion-capture on Hergé and actually gets the speed. A chase through a Moroccan city that feels like a comic panel with inertia.

movies.title: Pete's Dragon
movies.hook: A boy and a green CGI dragon in the Pacific Northwest, shot like a memory. The rare remake that is gentler than the original and means it.

movies.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
movies.hook: The kids sneak into an R-rated movie and America declares war on Canada. Cutout cardboard, filthy songs, and the smartest dumb movie of 1999.

movies.title: The Adventures of Prince Achmed
movies.hook: Lotte Reiniger’s silhouette Arabian Nights — the oldest surviving animated feature. Scissors, backlight, and a flying horse made of paper.

movies.title: Mary and Max
movies.hook: A lonely Australian girl and a lonely New Yorker become pen pals in clay. Elliot’s film is ugly-cute, then suddenly devastating.

movies.title: Chicken Run
movies.hook: POWs, but chickens, and a pie machine. Aardman does The Great Escape in plasticine and it is still their most perfect plot.

movies.title: The Lego Movie
movies.hook: Everything is awesome until Lord Business glues the world down. A toy commercial that becomes a film about play, and then about dad.

movies.title: Howl's Moving Castle
movies.hook: A cursed milliner, a wizard who is all hair and panic, a castle on chicken legs. Miyazaki’s war film wearing a love story’s coat.

movies.title: Your Name
movies.hook: Two teenagers swap bodies, then a comet writes the rest. Shinkai’s smash is a cry-in-the-dark blockbuster about missing someone you have not met.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
movies.hook: Cuaron takes the kids into puberty: a time-turner, a Hippogriff, and Hogwarts in actual weather. The one that looks like a film, not a catalog.
movies.wikipedia: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban (film)

movies.title: The Shape of Water
movies.hook: A mute cleaner and a river god in a Cold War lab. Del Toro’s creature romance is damp, sincere, and scored like a Fox musical.

movies.title: Big Fish
movies.hook: A dying father, a son who wants the facts, and stories that might be true because they are better. Burton’s warmest film is about the tall tale as love.

movies.title: Excalibur
movies.hook: Boorman’s Arthurian blast: chrome armor, fog, Wagner, and a Grail that looks dangerous. Myth as a wet, shining fever.

movies.title: The NeverEnding Story
movies.hook: A boy reads a book that is reading him back. The Luck Dragon, the Nothing, a theme song that still echoes in gymnasiums.

movies.title: The Green Knight
movies.hook: Dev Patel rides toward a bargain he does not understand. Lowery’s Arthurian trip is moss, ghosts, and the terror of becoming a story.

movies.title: Labyrinth
movies.hook: Jennifer Connelly wants her brother back; Bowie wants the baby and the hair. Henson’s maze is puppets, music, and teenage stubbornness.

movies.title: The Dark Crystal
movies.hook: No humans, only puppets in a dying world of crystal and Skeksis. Henson and Oz make a children’s film that is, frankly, not for children.

movies.title: Edward Scissorhands
movies.hook: A suburb, a topiary, an inventor’s unfinished boy. Burton’s fable is about what neighborhoods do to anyone who does not fit the mailbox.

movies.title: Stardust
movies.hook: A fallen star, a wall, witches who want her heart. Vaughn’s fairy tale is lighter than Gaiman’s book and proud of the extra jokes.

movies.title: Willow
movies.hook: Warwick Davis as a farmer with a destined baby, Val Kilmer as a swordsman with a drinking problem. Ron Howard’s high-fantasy romp still has bounce.

movies.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
movies.hook: A wardrobe, a lamp-post, a lion who is not tame. Adamson’s Narnia is snow, Turkish Delight, and a sibling war that feels like the Blitz.
movies.wikipedia: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe

movies.title: Sleepy Hollow
movies.hook: Depp’s Ichabod is a forensic fop in a pumpkin-headed county. Burton’s heads roll in a mist that looks painted, because it almost was.

movies.title: Crimson Peak
movies.hook: A writer marries into a rotting mansion that bleeds clay. Del Toro’s gothic is ghosts as interior decoration — and as a warning.

movies.title: Hellboy
movies.hook: Ron Perlman as a demon who likes cats and pancakes, punching Nazis out of folklore. Del Toro’s first Hellboy is pulpy, sad, and perfectly cast.

movies.title: Constantine
movies.hook: Keanu as a chain-smoking exorcist who has already been to hell and hated the service. A trenchcoat occult film that got weirder on rewatch.

movies.title: Ghostbusters
movies.hook: A proton pack, a marshmallow man, and New York treating the apocalypse as a municipal problem. The sci-fi comedy that became a folk religion.

movies.title: Midnight in Paris
movies.hook: A screenwriter steps into 1920s Paris every night at twelve. Allen’s lightest late film is about nostalgia as a taxi you should not live in.

movies.title: Oppenheimer
movies.hook: A physicist, a gadget, a hearing that is really a crucifixion. Nolan IMAX-es the conscience of the 20th century and lets the sound drop out.

movies.title: Schindler's List
movies.hook: A black-market charmer who starts collecting names. Spielberg’s most austere film is about the arithmetic of saving people — and the ones you cannot.

movies.title: Amadeus
movies.hook: Salieri narrates Mozart as a vulgar miracle. Forman’s costume epic is about envy so pure it becomes a kind of worship.

movies.title: Lincoln
movies.hook: Daniel Day-Lewis in a shawl, whipping votes for the 13th Amendment. Spielberg’s political procedural is almost all rooms, and it works.

movies.title: 12 Years a Slave
movies.hook: Solomon Northup, kidnapped into bondage, and McQueen will not look away. The rare awards film that is also a document of duration.

movies.title: The King's Speech
movies.hook: A stammering king and a colonial speech therapist in a shabby room. The abdication crisis as a buddy movie — and Colin Firth’s finest mumble.

movies.title: Gandhi
movies.hook: Attenborough’s sprawl, Kingsley’s stillness, a salt march that still photographs like a myth. The biopic as national founding — and as argument.

movies.title: Malcolm X
movies.hook: Denzel from zoot suit to hajj, Spike Lee staging American radicalism as a life that keeps converting. The biopic as a series of rebirths.

movies.title: The Zone of Interest
movies.hook: A family house over the wall from Auschwitz, the soundtrack doing the accusing. Glazer’s horror is domestic, banal, and unblinking.

movies.title: All Quiet on the Western Front
movies.hook: Remarque, again, in mud that looks like the end of color. A German-language trench film that treats every “advance” as a theft of boys.
movies.wikipedia: All Quiet on the Western Front (2022 film)

movies.title: Napoleon
movies.hook: Phoenix as a sulk in a bicorne, Scott as a battle DJ. The Austerlitz freeze, the Waterloo mud — an epic that is also a bad marriage.

movies.title: The Imitation Game
movies.hook: Cumberbatch’s Turing breaking Enigma and being broken by the state that needed him. A biopic with a thriller’s pulse and a bitter aftertaste.

movies.title: Braveheart
movies.hook: Gibson’s painted face, a hillside of pikes, history as a roar. Accurate? No. Stirring? The bagpipes have entered the chat.

movies.title: Barry Lyndon
movies.hook: Kubrick with natural light and a zoom that is a moral judgment. A rogue climbs the 18th century and the furniture outacts him.

movies.title: The Favourite
movies.hook: Two women, one queen, rabbits, and a dance that is a knife fight. Lanthimos’s court is filthy, funny, and lit like a conspiracy.

movies.title: Inglourious Basterds
movies.hook: Tarantino rewrites 1944 with a cinema fire and Christoph Waltz’s smiling multilingual devil. Alternate history as the revenge picture we were not allowed.

movies.title: Once Upon a Time in Hollywood
movies.hook: A fading actor, a stuntman, a Los Angeles that still has drive-ins. Tarantino’s sunset is warm until it decides, briefly, not to be.
movies.wikipedia: Once Upon a Time in Hollywood

movies.title: Watchmen
movies.hook: Superheroes who already lost, a squid, a watch that counts down. Snyder’s comic-panel film is alternate-history pulp with a broken heart.

movies.title: JFK
movies.hook: Stone’s kaleidoscope of the assassination: depositions, Zapruder, a New Orleans DA who will not stop talking. Paranoia as a film grammar.

movies.title: Darkest Hour
movies.hook: Gary Oldman’s Churchill, a war cabinet, an Underground car that may not have happened. The biopic as a two-week argument with surrender.

movies.title: All the President's Men
movies.hook: Typewriters, parking garages, two reporters following the money. Pakula makes bureaucracy look like a thriller because it was one.

movies.title: A Complete Unknown
movies.hook: Timothée as young Dylan going electric, Mangold staging the folk wars as a coming-of-age. A biopic that treats the songs as the plot.

movies.title: Halloween
movies.hook: A mask, a suburban street, a theme you can hum in the dark. Carpenter invents the slasher as a camera that just... walks.

movies.title: Scream
movies.hook: Ghostface calls, then lectures you on the rules. Craven and Williamson make the slasher self-aware without sanding off the jumps.

movies.title: 28 Days Later
movies.hook: Cillian Murphy wakes up to an empty London, then the infected arrive at a sprint. Boyle’s DV nightmare rewired the zombie for a new century.

movies.title: Night of the Living Dead
movies.hook: A farmhouse, a news bulletin, the dead who will not stay buried. Romero’s cheap, radical night that invented the modern zombie — and the ending that still stings.

movies.title: Train to Busan
movies.hook: A father, a daughter, a KTX full of the newly hungry. Yeon Sang-ho’s tearjerker-apocalypse is as much about seats and selfishness as bites.

movies.title: Nosferatu
movies.hook: Eggers’s plague-rat Count, a shadow that is a hand, Lily-Rose Depp as the invitation. A silent-film nightmare restaged with wet, breathing sound.

movies.title: [REC]
movies.hook: A TV reporter follows firefighters into a Barcelona building that will not let them leave. Found footage that actually moves — and then runs.

movies.title: The Blair Witch Project
movies.hook: Three students, a woods, a pile of sticks. The film that made you believe a website, and then made you hate camping.

movies.title: The Wolf Man
movies.hook: Lon Chaney Jr., a gypsy curse, fog-machine Wales. Universal’s lycanthrope template: tragedy in sideburns, and a walking stick with a silver knob.

movies.title: An American Werewolf in London
movies.hook: Two backpackers on the moors, then the most painful transformation ever put in latex. Landis’s horror-comedy is still the werewolf movie.

movies.title: Near Dark
movies.hook: A farm boy falls in with a vampire family who live in a van and burn in the dawn. Bigelow’s blood-western is dirty, sexy, and sun-phobic.

movies.title: Evil Dead II
movies.hook: Ash, a cabin, a chainsaw hand, and Raimi turning gore into slapstick physics. The splatter movie that is also a Tex Avery cartoon.

movies.title: Dawn of the Dead
movies.hook: The mall as the last suburb. Romero’s sequel is consumer satire with a shotgun — and still the most convincing end of the world in fluorescent light.

movies.title: Paranormal Activity
movies.hook: A couple points a camera at their bedroom and waits. The rare micro-budget that understood: the scare is in the timestamp.

movies.title: The Conjuring
movies.hook: The Warrens, a Rhode Island farmhouse, a clap that becomes folklore. Wan’s haunted-house picture is old-fashioned on purpose — and it works.

movies.title: The Ring
movies.hook: A videotape, seven days, a well. Verbinski’s American remake is wet, grey, and still the reason you side-eye a static TV.

movies.title: The Descent
movies.hook: Six women go caving; the cave goes back. Marshall’s claustrophobe is grief in a helmet lamp — and then it grows teeth.

movies.title: Host
movies.hook: A lockdown séance on Zoom, and the app is not the only thing that drops. The found-footage film that understood the little rectangle.

movies.title: The Howling
movies.hook: A TV reporter checks into a retreat that howls after dark. Dante’s werewolf film is media satire, then full-moon practical effects that still snap.

movies.title: Ginger Snaps
movies.hook: Two death-obsessed sisters, a bite, a puberty metaphor that actually has claws. Canadian lycanthropy with a sense of humor and a lot of fur.

movies.title: The Texas Chain Saw Massacre
movies.hook: A van, a house, a family dinner you will not forget. Hooper’s daylight nightmare is more suggestion than gore — and that is worse.

movies.title: Braindead
movies.hook: Peter Jackson before hobbits: a Sumatran rat-monkey, a lawnmower, an ocean of viscera. Splatter as a New Zealand garden party.

movies.title: Sinners
movies.hook: Coogler’s 1930s juke-joint vampire blues, Michael B. Jordan twice over. A period horror that treats music as blood — and as resistance.

movies.title: The Substance
movies.hook: Demi Moore takes a shortcut to a younger self and the body keeps the receipt. Fargeat’s feminist splatter is glamorous, then nauseating, on purpose.

movies.title: Weapons
movies.hook: Kids leave their homes at 2:17 a.m. and run into the dark. Cregger’s follow-up to Barbarian is a small-town mosaic that keeps tightening.

movies.title: Companion
movies.hook: A lakeside getaway, an AI girlfriend, a weekend that is a user agreement. A sleek little thriller about who owns the body in the passenger seat.

movies.title: This Is Spinal Tap
movies.hook: A rock documentary about a band that goes to 11. Reiner’s fake tour is still the reason real musicians cannot say “these go to eleven” with a straight face.

movies.title: Borat
movies.hook: Sacha Baron Cohen takes a Kazakh journalist across America and America cooperates. The mockumentary as a sting operation.

movies.title: Bridesmaids
movies.hook: Kristen Wiig’s maid of honor unravels in a dress shop, an airplane, a bridal shower. Female friendship as a demolition derby — with a heart.

movies.title: 21 Jump Street
movies.hook: Jonah Hill and Channing Tatum go undercover in high school and the joke is that they already peaked. Buddy-cop as a midlife crisis at 22.

movies.title: Tropic Thunder
movies.hook: Actors shooting a war movie wander into a real one. Stiller’s Hollywood roast is a parody that keeps finding a sharper knife.

movies.title: Blazing Saddles
movies.hook: Brooks sends a Black sheriff into a racist town and the fourth wall does not survive. A Western spoof that is still, somehow, ahead of its time.

movies.title: The General
movies.hook: Keaton, a locomotive, the Civil War, and stunts he actually did. Slapstick as engineering — the stone face driving into history.

movies.title: Modern Times
movies.hook: Chaplin versus the assembly line, the feeding machine, the factory. Slapstick as a labor theory — and a dance on roller skates.

movies.title: His Girl Friday
movies.hook: Hawks cranks the overlapping dialogue until it becomes music. A newsroom screwball about a remarriage, a hanging, and the scoop of a lifetime.

movies.title: Bringing Up Baby
movies.hook: Cary Grant, Katharine Hepburn, a leopard named Baby, and a missing dinosaur bone. Screwball as a collision you do not want to avoid.

movies.title: Dr. Strangelove
movies.hook: Kubrick’s nuclear farce: a cowboy on a bomb, a war room, a gloved salute. The end of the world as a joke that is not joking.

movies.title: Fargo
movies.hook: A kidnapping in Minnesota that will not stay simple. The Coens’ “true story” is snow, wood chippers, and Marge Gunderson’s quiet competence.

movies.title: Spotlight
movies.hook: The Boston Globe’s investigation unit vs. a city’s secrets. McCarthy’s procedural is all fluorescent rooms — and it lands like a punch.

movies.title: The Trial of the Chicago 7
movies.hook: Sorkin puts 1968 in the dock: seven defendants, a judge who is the villain, a riot that keeps being restaged. Courtroom as a rock concert.

movies.title: A Few Good Men
movies.hook: You cannot handle the truth, and Tom Cruise is going to ask for it anyway. Reiner’s courtroom fireworks are still the template for the stand-up moment.

movies.title: Erin Brockovich
movies.hook: Julia Roberts in a miniskirt taking on PG&E with a file box. Soderbergh’s legal drama is a true story that plays like a crowd-pleaser — because it is.

movies.title: Philadelphia
movies.hook: Hanks as a lawyer fired for getting sick; Washington as the lawyer who does not want the case. Demme’s AIDS drama is a closing argument with a heartbeat.

movies.title: 12 Angry Men
movies.hook: A jury room, a heat wave, one holdout. Lumet’s debut is still the civics lesson that plays like a thriller — all talk, all stakes.

movies.title: Just Mercy
movies.hook: Michael B. Jordan as Bryan Stevenson, taking a death-row case the system already closed. A legal drama about the long work of making the law tell the truth.

movies.title: Awakenings
movies.hook: De Niro frozen, Williams unfreezing him, Oliver Sacks in the wings. A medical drama about the cruelty of a miracle that is only borrowed.

movies.title: The Elephant Man
movies.hook: Lynch in black and white, Hurt as Merrick, a Victorian hospital that is both sanctuary and circus. Tenderness as a medical and moral act.

movies.title: Contagion
movies.hook: A handshake, a virus, a montage of institutions trying to keep up. Soderbergh’s procedural felt like a warning; then it felt like a documentary.

movies.title: Dallas Buyers Club
movies.hook: McConaughey’s Ron Woodroof smuggling hope across a border the FDA will not. A medical biopic with hustle, rage, and an unlikely alliance.

movies.title: Mr. Smith Goes to Washington
movies.hook: A naive scout leader filibusters the Senate until his voice gives out. Capra’s civics fable is corn, then it is a dare.

movies.title: The Big Short
movies.hook: McKay explains CDOs with Margot Robbie in a bubble bath, then the housing market falls on everyone. A crash as a dark comedy you already lived through.

movies.title: Zero Dark Thirty
movies.hook: Bigelow’s hunt for bin Laden is a decade of rooms, then a house in Abbottabad. A procedural that will not let you look away from the cost.

movies.title: United 93
movies.hook: Greengrass restages one morning in real time, from Newark to a field in Pennsylvania. Docudrama as a held breath — no speeches, just procedure and courage.

movies.title: Black Swan
movies.hook: Portman as a dancer splitting in half for Swan Lake. Aronofsky’s psychological horror is nail beds, mirrors, and a mother in the wings.

movies.title: Taxi Driver
movies.hook: De Niro’s Travis Bickle, an insomnia diary, a city that looks like a fever. Scorsese’s night drive is still the American loneliness movie.

movies.title: The Breakfast Club
movies.hook: Five detentions, one Saturday, a letter to Mr. Vernon. Hughes’s teen mosaic is still the permission slip to be more than your locker.

movies.title: Eighth Grade
movies.hook: Elsie Fisher’s Kayla makes YouTube videos nobody watches and walks into a pool party. Burnham’s phone-era teen film is excruciating, then kind.

movies.title: Boyhood
movies.hook: Linklater shoots the same kid for twelve years and calls it a plot. Growing up as a time-lapse — ordinary days, then a sudden adult.

movies.title: Dune: Part Two
movies.hook: Villeneuve finishes the messiah trap: sandworms, a holy war, Zendaya’s Chani as the conscience. Spectacle that still remembers to be bitter.

movies.title: Wicked
movies.hook: Cynthia Erivo and Ariana Grande go green and go big. Chu’s Oz prequel is a friendship, a propaganda machine, and a Defying Gravity that earns the IMAX.

movies.title: Anora
movies.hook: Mikey Madison’s stripper-bride and a Brighton Beach kidnapping that is also a farce. Baker’s Palme d’Or is vulgar, tender, and in a hurry.

movies.title: Conclave
movies.hook: Ralph Fiennes as a cardinal managing a papal election that will not stay holy. Berger’s chamber piece is whispers, smoke, and a late card up the sleeve.

movies.title: Mickey 17
movies.hook: Pattinson as an expendable colonist who keeps dying and coming back slightly wrong. Bong Joon-ho’s space satire is a clone joke with teeth.

movies.title: F1
movies.hook: Brad Pitt in a cockpit, Kosinski shooting like Top Gun went to Silverstone. A racing movie that treats the camera as a passenger with a death wish.

movies.title: Demolition
movies.hook: An emotionally desperate investment banker finds hope through a woman he meets.

movies.title: The Last House
movies.hook: A family suddenly sealed inside their home must work together to survive against dwindling resources and the ominous threat keeping them trapped.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
movies.hook: Following the events of Captain America: Civil War, Peter Parker, with the help of his mentor Tony Stark, tries to balance his life as an ordinary high school student in Queens, New York City, with fighting crime as his superhero alter ego Spider-Man as a new threat, the Vulture, emerges.

movies.title: Mystic River
movies.hook: The lives of three men who were childhood friends are shattered when one of them suffers a family tragedy.

movies.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
movies.hook: Peter Parker and his friends go on a summer trip to Europe. However, they will hardly be able to rest - Peter will have to agree to help Nick Fury uncover the mystery of creatures that cause natural disasters and destruction throughout the continent.

movies.title: Spider-Man
movies.hook: After being bitten by a genetically altered spider at Oscorp, nerdy but endearing high school student Peter Parker is endowed with amazing powers to become the superhero known as Spider-Man.

movies.title: Practical Magic
movies.hook: Sally and Gillian Owens, born into a magical family, have mostly avoided witchcraft themselves. But when Gillian's vicious boyfriend, Jimmy Angelov, dies unexpectedly, the Owens sisters give themselves a crash course in hard magic. With policeman Gary Hallet growing suspicious, the girls struggle to resurrect Angelov -- and unwittingly inject his corpse with an evil spirit that threatens to end their family line.

movies.title: Game Night
movies.hook: Max and Annie's weekly game night gets kicked up a notch when Max's brother Brooks arranges a murder mystery party -- complete with fake thugs and federal agents. So when Brooks gets kidnapped, it's all supposed to be part of the game. As the competitors set out to solve the case, they start to learn that neither the game nor Brooks are what they seem to be. The friends soon find themselves in over their heads as each twist leads to another unexpected turn over the course of one chaotic night.

movies.title: Jurassic Park
movies.hook: A wealthy entrepreneur secretly creates a theme park featuring living dinosaurs drawn from prehistoric DNA. Before opening day, he invites a team of experts and his two eager grandchildren to experience the park and help calm anxious investors. However, the park is anything but amusing as the security systems go off-line and the dinosaurs escape.

movies.title: The Condemned
movies.hook: Jack Conrad is awaiting the death penalty in a corrupt Central American prison. He is "purchased" by a wealthy television producer and taken to a desolate island where he must fight to the death against nine other condemned killers from all corners of the world, with freedom going to the sole survivor.

movies.title: Kraven the Hunter
movies.hook: Kraven Kravinoff's complex relationship with his ruthless gangster father, Nikolai, starts him down a path of vengeance with brutal consequences, motivating him to become not only the greatest hunter in the world, but also one of its most feared.

movies.title: Mortal Kombat
movies.hook: Washed-up MMA fighter Cole Young, unaware of his heritage, and hunted by Emperor Shang Tsung's best warrior, Sub-Zero, seeks out and trains with Earth's greatest champions as he prepares to stand against the enemies of Outworld in a high stakes battle for the universe.

movies.title: 72 HOURS
movies.hook: To save his career, a 40-year-old ad exec joins a crew of twentysomethings for a wild Miami bachelor party after they mistakenly add him to a group chat.

movies.title: Extinction
movies.hook: And suddenly, overnight, the world came to a halt. Two men, two survivors, one kid, and hatred that separates them. A place forgotten by everyone, including the creatures that inhabit the Earth... until now.

movies.title: The Island
movies.hook: In 2019, Lincoln Six-Echo is a resident of a seemingly "Utopian" but contained facility. Like all of the inhabitants of this carefully-controlled environment, Lincoln hopes to be chosen to go to The Island — reportedly the last uncontaminated location on the planet. But Lincoln soon discovers that everything about his existence is a lie.

movies.title: A Minecraft Movie
movies.hook: Four misfits are suddenly pulled through a mysterious portal into a bizarre cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home they'll have to master this world while embarking on a quest with an unexpected expert crafter.

movies.title: Crazy, Stupid, Love.
movies.hook: Cal Weaver is living the American dream. He has a good job, a beautiful house, great children and a beautiful wife, named Emily. Cal's seemingly perfect life unravels, however, when he learns that Emily has been unfaithful and wants a divorce. Over 40 and suddenly single, Cal is adrift in the fickle world of dating. Enter, Jacob Palmer, a self-styled player who takes Cal under his wing and teaches him how to be a hit with the ladies.

movies.title: War Machine
movies.hook: On one last grueling mission during Army Ranger training, a combat engineer must lead his unit in a fight against a giant otherworldly killing machine.

movies.title: The Creator
movies.hook: Amid a future war between the human race and the forces of artificial intelligence, a hardened ex-special forces agent grieving the disappearance of his wife, is recruited to hunt down and kill the Creator, the elusive architect of advanced AI who has developed a mysterious weapon with the power to end the war—and mankind itself.

movies.title: The Wild Robot
movies.hook: After a shipwreck, an intelligent robot called Roz is stranded on an uninhabited island. To survive the harsh environment, Roz bonds with the island's animals and cares for an orphaned baby goose.

movies.title: Training Day
movies.hook: A rookie cop spends his first day as a Los Angeles narcotics officer with a rogue detective who isn't what he appears to be.

movies.title: The Worst Person in the World
movies.hook: The chronicles of four years in the life of Julie, a young woman who navigates the troubled waters of her love life and struggles to find her career path, leading her to take a realistic look at who she really is.
movies.wikipedia: The Worst Person in the World

movies.title: Enola Holmes 3
movies.hook: Detective Enola Holmes heads to Malta, where her aspirations merge in her most complex and dangerous case yet.

movies.title: Go
movies.hook: A supermarket clerk decides to step in for an absent drug dealer, setting off an explosive, comedic chain of events.

movies.title: Voicemails for Isabelle
movies.hook: A young woman's hilariously confessional voicemails to her late sister are unknowingly redirected to a stranger, who begins to fall in love from afar.

movies.title: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
movies.hook: Bilbo Baggins, a hobbit enjoying his quiet life, is swept into an epic quest by Gandalf the Grey and thirteen dwarves who seek to reclaim their mountain home from Smaug, the dragon.

movies.title: The Guns of Navarone
movies.hook: A team of allied saboteurs are assigned an impossible mission: infiltrate an impregnable Nazi-held island and destroy the two enormous long-range field guns that prevent the rescue of 2,000 trapped British soldiers.

movies.title: A Toxic Love Story
movies.hook: A string of threatening e-mails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly-married US Marshal and his ex-girlfriend.

movies.title: Wake Up Dead Man: A Knives Out Mystery
movies.hook: When young priest Jud Duplenticy is sent to assist charismatic firebrand Monsignor Jefferson Wicks, it’s clear that all is not well in the pews. After a sudden and seemingly impossible murder rocks the town, the lack of an obvious suspect prompts local police chief Geraldine Scott to join forces with renowned detective Benoit Blanc to unravel a mystery that defies all logic.
movies.wikipedia: Wake Up Dead Man: A Knives Out Mystery

movies.hook: In the ancient battle of Thermopylae, King Leonidas and 300 Spartans fight against Xerxes and his massive Persian army.

movies.title: Green Book
movies.hook: Tony Lip, a bouncer in 1962, is hired to drive pianist Don Shirley on a tour through the Deep South in the days when African Americans, forced to find alternate accommodations and services due to segregation laws below the Mason-Dixon Line, relied on a guide called The Negro Motorist Green Book.

movies.title: Desperado
movies.hook: El Mariachi plunges headfirst into the dark border underworld when he follows a trail of blood to the last of the infamous Mexican drug lords, Bucho, for an action-packed, bullet-riddled showdown. With the help of his friend and a beautiful bookstore owner, El Mariachi tracks Bucho, takes on his army of desperados, and leaves his own trail of blood.

movies.title: Charlie Wilson's War
movies.hook: A Texas congressman sets a series of events in motion when he conspires with a CIA operative to aid Afghan mujahideen rebels fighting the Soviets.

movies.title: Jurassic World: Fallen Kingdom
movies.hook: When the island's dormant volcano begins roaring to life, Owen and Claire mount a campaign to rescue the remaining dinosaurs from this extinction-level event.

movies.title: Spider-Man 2
movies.hook: Peter Parker is going through a major identity crisis. Burned out from being Spider-Man, he decides to shelve his superhero alter ego, which leaves the city suffering in the wake of carnage left by the evil Doc Ock. In the meantime, Parker still can't act on his feelings for Mary Jane Watson, a girl he's loved since childhood. A certain anger begins to brew in his best friend Harry Osborn as well...

movies.title: Gladiator II
movies.hook: After his home is conquered by the tyrannical emperors who now lead Rome, Lucius is forced to enter the Colosseum and must look to his past to find strength to return the glory of Rome to its people.

movies.title: The Accountant
movies.hook: As a math savant uncooks the books for a new client, the Treasury Department closes in on his activities and the body count starts to rise.

movies.title: Fight Club
movies.hook: A ticking-time-bomb insomniac and a slippery soap salesman channel primal male aggression into a shocking new form of therapy. Their concept catches on, with underground "fight clubs" forming in every town, until an eccentric gets in the way and ignites an out-of-control spiral toward oblivion.

movies.title: John Q
movies.hook: John Quincy Archibald is a father and husband whose son is diagnosed with an enlarged heart and then finds out he cannot receive a transplant because HMO insurance will not cover it. Therefore, he decides to take a hospital full of patients hostage until the hospital puts his son's name on the donor's list.

movies.title: Man of Steel
movies.hook: A young boy learns that he has extraordinary powers and is not of this earth. As a young man, he journeys to discover where he came from and what he was sent here to do. But the hero in him must emerge if he is to save the world from annihilation and become the symbol of hope for all mankind.

movies.title: Hollow Man
movies.hook: Cocky researcher Sebastian Caine is working on a project to make living creatures invisible. Determined to achieve the ultimate breakthrough, Caine pushes his team to move to the next phase — using himself as the subject. The test is a success, but when the process can't be reversed and Caine seems doomed to future without flesh, he starts to turn increasingly dangerous.

movies.title: Kill Bill: Vol. 1
movies.hook: An assassin is shot by her ruthless employer, Bill, and other members of their assassination circle – but she lives to plot her vengeance.

movies.title: Don't Say Good Luck
movies.hook: Sophie Birenbaum is ready for the spotlight as the lead in her high school musical — until she's suddenly facing more drama at home than on the stage.

movies.title: The Imaginarium of Doctor Parnassus
movies.hook: After a carnival troupe saves his life, a man agrees to help its immortal leader collect five souls and win a bet with the devil.

movies.title: Primal Fear
movies.hook: Defense attorney Martin Vail takes on jobs for money and prestige rather than any sense of the greater good. His latest case involves an altar boy, accused of brutally murdering the archbishop of Chicago. Vail finds himself up against his ex-pupil and ex-lover, but as the case progresses and the Church's dark secrets are revealed, Vail finds that what appeared a simple case takes on a darker, more dangerous aspect.

movies.title: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo
movies.hook: Swedish thriller based on Stieg Larsson's novel about a male journalist and a young female hacker. In the opening of the movie, Mikael Blomkvist, a middle-aged publisher for the magazine Millennium, loses a libel case brought by corrupt Swedish industrialist Hans-Erik Wennerström. Nevertheless, he is hired by Henrik Vanger in order to solve a cold case, the disappearance of Vanger's niece
movies.wikipedia: The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo

movies.title: Ghost Town
movies.hook: Bertram Pincus, a cranky, people-hating Manhattan dentist, develops the unwelcome ability to see dead people. Really annoying dead people. Even worse, they all want something from him, particularly Frank Herlihy, a smooth-talking ghost, who pesters him into a romantic scheme involving his widow Gwen. They are soon entangled in a hilarious predicament between the now and the hereafter!

movies.title: Mr. Church
movies.hook: A unique friendship develops when a little girl and her dying mother inherit a cook - Mr. Church. What begins as an arrangement that should only last six months, instead spans fifteen years.

movies.title: Enola Holmes
movies.hook: While searching for her missing mother, intrepid teen Enola Holmes uses her sleuthing skills to outsmart big brother Sherlock and help a runaway lord.

movies.title: Apex
movies.hook: A mountain climber haunted by a fatal decision in Norway retreats to the Australian wilderness for isolation. Her journey turns into a desperate hunt when a deceptive local targets her as his next ritualistic prey in the bush.

movies.title: Remarkably Bright Creatures
movies.hook: Through unlikely bonds formed during night shifts at a local aquarium, Tova, an elderly widow, learns of a life-changing discovery that may bring her joy and wonder once again.

movies.title: The Hangover
movies.hook: When three friends finally come to after a raucous night of bachelor-party revelry, they find a baby in the closet and a tiger in the bathroom. But they can't seem to locate their best friend, Doug – who's supposed to be tying the knot. Launching a frantic search for Doug, the trio perseveres through a nasty hangover to try to make it to the church on time.

movies.title: The Amazing Spider-Man 2
movies.hook: For Peter Parker, life is busy. Between taking out the bad guys as Spider-Man and spending time with the person he loves, Gwen Stacy, high school graduation cannot come quickly enough. Peter has not forgotten about the promise he made to Gwen’s father to protect her by staying away, but that is a promise he cannot keep. Things will change for Peter when a new villain, Electro, emerges, an old friend, Harry Osborn, returns, and Peter uncovers new clues about his past.

movies.title: Inside the Trustor Scandal
movies.hook: For the first time since 1997, Joachim Posener finally emerges from hiding and allows himself to be interviewed about his life and the Trustor affair. Twenty-seven years ago, he disappeared without a trace, and ever since, he has been on the international most wanted list. Now, Karin af Klintberg searches for him to find out how he lives and where he's been hiding all these years. But perhaps above all, to uncover what everyone is wondering: Was he guilty? Through new and opposing testimonies from never-before-heard voices, Karin simultaneously continues the search for the truth about the coup. How could five people swindle 600 million kr and still go free? And where did the money actually go?

movies.title: Spider-Man 3
movies.hook: The seemingly invincible Spider-Man goes up against an all-new crop of villains—including the shape-shifting Sandman. While Spider-Man’s superpowers are altered by an alien organism, his alter ego, Peter Parker, deals with nemesis Eddie Brock and also gets caught up in a love triangle.

movies.title: Sully
movies.hook: On 15 January 2009, the world witnessed the 'Miracle on the Hudson' when Captain 'Sully' Sullenberger glided his disabled plane onto the Hudson River, saving the lives of all 155 souls aboard. However, even as Sully was being heralded by the public and the media for his unprecedented feat of aviation skill, an investigation was unfolding that threatened to destroy his reputation and career.

movies.title: The Rite
movies.hook: Seminary student Michael Kovak reluctantly attends exorcism school at the Vatican. While he’s in Rome, Michael meets an unorthodox priest who introduces him to the darker side of his faith, uncovering the devil’s reach even to one of the holiest places on Earth.

movies.title: Venom: The Last Dance
movies.hook: Eddie and Venom are on the run. Hunted by both of their worlds and with the net closing in, the duo are forced into a devastating decision that will bring the curtains down on Venom and Eddie's last dance.

movies.title: Love Hurts
movies.hook: A realtor is pulled back into the life he left behind after his former partner-in-crime resurfaces with an ominous message. With his crime-lord brother also on his trail, he must confront his past and the history he never fully buried.

movies.title: The Truman Show
movies.hook: In a picture-perfect seaside town, an insurance salesman begins to realize that his entire existence may be staged and observed by a vast unseen audience as part of a long-running real-time reality TV show.

movies.title: Argo
movies.hook: As the Iranian revolution reaches a boiling point, a CIA 'exfiltration' specialist concocts a risky plan to free six Americans who have found shelter at the home of the Canadian ambassador.

movies.title: Starship Troopers: Invasion
movies.hook: The troopers of two starships have joined forces to terminate a massive bug attack at a Federation outpost. Before the mission can be completed and the survivors evacuated, one ship abruptly departs and goes inexplicably dark. The remaining battle-hardened troopers race to the rescue only to discover that the threat from the bugs is about to hit home.

movies.title: Infinite
movies.hook: Evan McCauley has skills he never learned and memories of places he has never visited. Self-medicated and on the brink of a mental breakdown, a secret group that call themselves “Infinites” come to his rescue, revealing that his memories are real.

movies.title: Train Dreams
movies.hook: A logger leads a life of quiet grace as he experiences love and loss during an era of monumental change in early 20th-century America.

movies.title: I Saw the TV Glow
movies.hook: In late-90s suburbia, a lonely teenager meets a girl at school who introduces him to a mysterious late-night T.V. show — a vision of a supernatural world pulsing beneath their own. As time goes on, however, questions begin to arise about why the show sometimes seems more real than their own lives. In the pale glow of the television, their view of reality begins to crack.

movies.title: Another Round
movies.hook: Four stagnant high school teachers decide to test out a theory that maintaining a constant level of intoxication will improve their overall lives.

movies.title: The Fast and the Furious
movies.hook: Dominic Toretto is a Los Angeles street racer suspected of masterminding a series of big-rig hijackings. When undercover cop Brian O'Conner infiltrates Toretto's iconoclastic crew, he falls for Toretto's sister and must choose a side: the gang or the LAPD.

movies.title: Darkland: The Return
movies.hook: Seven years ago, Zaid went to war against the Copenhagen underworld to avenge his dead brother. His identity as a respected doctor of cardiology and life as a family man is but a fading dream, and in prison Zaid suffers the loss of his son Noah, whom he barely knows. When a police agent approaches Zaid and offers him a deal to be released in exchange for infiltrating the Copenhagen underworld, he sees his chance to reclaim the remnants of the family life he left behind. But everything has a price, and Zaid realizes that he has now seriously endangered his son's life. After all, once you become part of the underworld, is there any way out?

movies.title: Resident Evil
movies.hook: When a virus leaks from a top-secret facility, turning all resident researchers into ravenous zombies and their lab animals into mutated hounds from hell, the government sends in an elite military task force to contain the outbreak.

movies.title: War Dogs
movies.hook: Based on the true story of two young men, David Packouz and Efraim Diveroli, who won a $300 million contract from the Pentagon to arm America's allies in Afghanistan.

movies.title: Final Destination Bloodlines
movies.hook: Plagued by a violent recurring nightmare, college student Stefanie heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

movies.title: She's Out of My League
movies.hook: When he starts dating drop-dead gorgeous Molly, insecure airport security agent Kirk can't believe it. As his friends and family share their doubts about the relationship lasting, Kirk does everything he can to avoid losing Molly forever.

movies.title: The Room Next Door
movies.hook: Ingrid and Martha were close friends in their youth, when they worked together at the same magazine. Ingrid went on to become an autofiction novelist while Martha became a war reporter, and they were separated by the circumstances of life. After years of being out of touch, they meet again in an extreme but strangely sweet situation.

movies.title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
movies.hook: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

movies.title: The Hunt
movies.hook: Twelve strangers wake up in a clearing. They don't know where they are—or how they got there. In the shadow of a dark internet conspiracy theory, ruthless elitists gather at a remote location to hunt humans for sport. But their master plan is about to be derailed when one of the hunted turns the tables on her pursuers.

movies.title: Deep Impact
movies.hook: A seven-mile-wide space rock is hurtling toward Earth, threatening to obliterate the planet. Now, it's up to the president of the United States to save the world. He appoints a tough-as-nails veteran astronaut to lead a joint American-Russian crew into space to destroy the comet before impact. Meanwhile, an enterprising reporter uses her smarts to uncover the scoop of the century.

movies.title: He's Just Not That Into You
movies.hook: Have you ever wondered why they said they would call but didn't, or why they don't want to sleep with you anymore, or why your relationship isn't going to the next level? Maybe they're just not that into you. Gigi wants a man who says he'll call her - and actually does - while Alex advises her to stop waiting by the phone. Beth wants a proposal after years of a committed relationship with her boyfriend, Neil, who is just fine with the way things are. Janine's not sure if she can trust her husband, Ben, who can't quite trust himself around Anna. Anna can't decide between the sexy married guy or her straightforward, no-sparks standby, Conor, who can't get over the fact that he can't have her. And Mary, who's found an entire network of loving, supportive men, just needs to find one who's straight.
movies.wikipedia: He's Just Not That Into You

movies.title: Second Victims
movies.hook: During a hectic shift in the neurological department, skilled doctor Alexandra takes on extra responsibility. But a misjudgment ends in tragedy.

movies.title: The Four Seasons
movies.hook: Three middle-aged wealthy couples take vacations together in Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter. Along the way we are treated to mid-life, marital, parental and other crises.

movies.title: Horrible Bosses
movies.hook: For Nick, Kurt and Dale, the only thing that would make the daily grind more tolerable would be to grind their intolerable bosses into dust. Quitting is not an option, so, with the benefit of a few-too-many drinks and some dubious advice from a hustling ex-con, the three friends devise a convoluted and seemingly foolproof plan to rid themselves of their respective employers... permanently.

movies.title: Crawl
movies.hook: When a huge hurricane hits her hometown in Florida, Haley ignores evacuation orders to look for her father. After finding him badly wounded, both are trapped by the flood. With virtually no time to escape the storm, they discover that rising water levels are the least of their problems.

movies.title: Seven Pounds
movies.hook: An IRS agent with a fateful secret embarks on an extraordinary journey of redemption by forever changing the lives of seven strangers.

movies.title: Heartstopper Forever
movies.hook: Nick and Charlie are in love, but new challenges lay ahead with Nick getting ready to leave for university and Charlie taking on new responsibilities at school.

movies.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
movies.hook: Andy Sachs returns to Runway as Miranda Priestly navigates a new media landscape and Runway's position within. The duo reconnect with former assistant Emily Charlton, now the head of a luxury brand that possesses funding which could ensure Runway's survival.

movies.title: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come
movies.hook: Moments after surviving an all-out attack from the Le Domas family, Grace discovers she’s reached the next level of the nightmarish game — and this time with her estranged sister Faith at her side. Grace has one chance to survive, keep her sister alive, and claim the High Seat of the Council that controls the world. Four rival families are hunting her for the throne, and whoever wins rules it all.
movies.wikipedia: Ready or Not 2: Here I Come

movies.title: Send Help
movies.hook: Two colleagues become stranded on a deserted island, the only survivors of a plane crash. On the island, they must overcome past grievances and work together to survive, but ultimately, it's a battle of wills and wits to make it out alive.

movies.title: Avatar: Fire and Ash
